OIDC uses the dedicated task-delivery service account in the queue project. Cloud Tasks generates Authorization: Bearer; never supply a static token or trust X-CloudTasks-* headers as authentication.
Use the worker's stable Cloud Run origin as the exact audience, without /internal/tasks/crm. The HTTPS target includes that path. Keep these values identical to worker settings.
The queue-level ALWAYS override fixes the HTTPS host/path/method and OIDC identity/audience for every task; task-level descriptions repeat the same reviewed values.
Replace body with base64-encoded UTF-8 JSON containing only the actual persisted workspace_id and event_id UUIDs. Do not put contact data, credentials or booking descriptions into the task.

Google's retry policy stops failures after both maxAttempts and maxRetryDuration are satisfied. The numbers below are not an either/or hard cap; confirm observed retries on hosted acceptance.
